title: Heavenly Secrets First Manifest
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing fell silent for a moment before asking coldly, 'In your prophecy, have you seen your own death?' Those deep purple eyes flickered with complex light, as if reassessing the man she had deemed atrash.

text.content: Shattered porcelain fragments scattered across the floor, the splashed tea water gleaming coldly under the candlelight. Ye Qing's slender fingers still maintained the position from when she had slammed the table, purple-black spiritual energy coiling around her fingertips like snake tongues, the hall's temperature dropping three degrees. The two Demonic Path envoys had already activated their artifacts, eerie green light sealing off all of Chen Ji's escape routes. "Laugh?" Ye Qing's voice seemed to come from the Nine Abyssses, each word carrying bone-penetrating coldness, "Chen Ji, do you know where the last person who dared to laugh in my presence is buried?" Her purple eyes burned with killing intent that nearly solidified into form, the天魔诀technique forming a faint blood-colored veil around her. The dignified Demonic Path Saint, at this moment, had truly flown into a rage. The spiritual energy fluctuations in the air grew increasingly violent, as if the next moment would trigger a battle capable of flattening this teahouse.

Yet facing such terrifying pressure, Chen Ji calmly lifted the teacup before him, gently blowing away the浮沫. That action was tranquil to the point of eeriness, as if he were not in a desperate situation but enjoying tea and admiring the moon in his own backyard. He even slightly tilted his head, as if listening to something, the smile at the corner of his lips not only unconstrained but growing deeper. "Miss Ye Qing," he finally spoke, his voice unhurried, "what you are about to say is—'Atrashfrom Tianqing Sect dares to play tricks before me?' The hall instantly fell deathly silent. The two Demonic Path envoys exchanged bewildered glances. Ye Qing's delicate brow furrowed slightly, yet her killing intent showed no decrease. "Do you think that speaking some nonsensical words can—"

"Can shake my composure?" Chen Ji smoothly took over her words, his tone carrying a hint of languid laughter, "You've already said that, Miss Ye Qing. Why not try a new threat?" His fingertips tapped lightly on the table, producing a rhythmic sound. However, in the next moment, his gaze abruptly changed—within those originally ordinary eyes, two wisps of pale golden light suddenly emerged, like dawn's first light piercing through the clouds, mysterious and solemn. The Tianji Record Fragment was officially activated at this moment, fine intricate patterns emerging in the depths of Chen Ji's pupils, forming two ancient seal characters—the primordial writing of 'Heavenly Secrets,' containing the supreme principles of fate and reincarnation. The air in the hall seemed to solidify. Ye Qing's originally fierce momentum was quietly suppressed by an invisible force.

dialogue.content: "First breath, you will withdraw your right hand." Chen Ji's voice was low and calm, as if stating an established fact, "Because your confidant saw an unexpected variable in that blood shadow—yes, this aura of mine that you have never seen before." He lightly brushed his sleeve, an invisible spirit pattern flickering briefly around him. That was the residual heavenly principle lingering from the Tianji Record's activation, containing the mysteries of fate's gears turning. The pupils of both Demonic Path envoys contracted simultaneously—they had indeed seen the abnormality in the blood shadow earlier, yet had never mentioned it to anyone. How did thistrashknow about it?

text.content: Ye Qing's body stiffened slightly. She instinctively wanted to deny it, yet found her right hand had already dropped to her side involuntarily, as if pulled by some invisible force. That movement was gentle and natural, yet precisely terrifying—one that perfectly matched Chen Ji's prophecy. "Second breath, you will ask how I knew about this." Chen Ji continued, his tone as casual as a daily greeting, "But you will soon discover this question is meaningless." He raised his hand lightly, a illusory image appearing in his palm—a blurry vision of a majestic palace, a figure in purple robes standing within. The image flickered unstably, yet clearly marked a time point: three hours from now.

dialogue.content: "You..." Ye Qing finally lost her voice. Her tone was no longer the previous icy sharpness, but carried an undeniable tremor. As a Demonic Path Saint, she had witnessed countless rare treasures and secret techniques, yet never such a bizarre scene—someone actually able to foresee her next move with perfect accuracy. "Third breath, you will step back." Chen Ji's gaze fell upon her, as if observing a priceless treasure, "Because your intuition tells you that what I am now displaying is far more dangerous than you imagined." Before his words even finished, Ye Qing's figure had already stepped back. That was a本能defensive reaction, one even she had not anticipated. The hall fell completely silent, only the water vapor from the residual tea rose steadily, refracting dreamlike colors in the golden light. The two Demonic Path envoys had turned ashen pale—they had never seen their Saint retreat even half a step before anyone.

text.content: Ye Qing's breathing quickened. Those purple eyes flickered with complex emotions—shock, confusion, anger, and a hint of curiosity she herself was unwilling to admit. She was a Demonic Path Saint, raised as a tool since childhood, well-versed in the treachery of human hearts, yet had never encountered such unbelievable abilities. "Who exactly are you?" Her voice was low and dangerous, completely different from her earlier aggression, "An outer disciple from Tianqing Sect could never possess such skills." Chen Ji smiled lightly, dispersing the illusory image in his palm. The golden light slowly faded, retreating into the depths of his pupils, leaving only a faint lingering presence. He lifted his teacup, took a small sip, his expression so leisurely it was as if everything just now had been nothing more than a boring trick.

"Fourth breath, you will order your subordinates to withdraw." Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, "Because the following conversation is not suitable for a third person to hear." His gaze calmly swept across the two Demonic Path envoys, that gaze as indifferent as still water, yet making both feel as if they had fallen into an icy abyss. Ye Qing's lips trembled slightly, as if wanting to protest, yet her right hand had already risen, making a gesture to dismiss them. The two envoys exchanged glances, their faces full of disbelief, yet not daring to disobey the Saint's command, they bowed and retreated outside the hall. The heavy doors slowly closed behind them, sealing all sounds from the outside world. In the spacious great hall, only Chen Ji and Ye Qing remained seated across from each other, tea fragrance drifting, killing intent undiminished.

dialogue.content: "Fifth breath, you will ask about the source of this ability." Chen Ji set down his teacup, his fingers gently stroking the rim, those eyes as deep as if harboring endless starry skies, "But I am not in the mood to answer that question right now." A meaningful curve appeared at the corner of his lips, "Because beyond that, what I am more curious about is—Miss Ye Qing, have you ever wondered why the Holy Sect sent you to this insignificant Tianqing Sect?" This sentence was like a sharp blade, precisely stabbing the softest part of Ye Qing's heart. Her body obviously stiffened, a extremely hidden pain flickering in those purple eyes. How could thistrashknow the Holy Sect's secrets? Chen Ji noted all her reactions, already having calculations in his heart. The Tianji Record's first official use, the effect was even better than he had anticipated.

"Sixth breath, you will be silent." Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of teasing, "Seventh breath, you will recall a picture you do not want to remember. Eighth breath, you will begin to reassess my value." He stood up, for the first time adopting a居高临下的 posture to look down upon this Demonic Path Saint, "Ninth breath, you will make a decision—whether to kill me to silence me, or to hear my terms." Ye Qing's figure remained motionless, only the light in those purple eyesfluctuationing intensely. She truly had recalled a certain scene—a long time ago, when she was still an innocent girl, the first time the Holy Sect used her as a discarded pawn. How could thistrashpossibly foresee even this? Chen Ji lightly brushed his sleeves, as if just removing nonexistent dust.

text.content: "Tenth breath." Chen Ji's voice echoed through the great hall, carrying an undeniable authority, "You will ask me—since you can foresee the future, have you seen your own death?" Ye Qing's body shuddered violently. Those words were like thunder in her mind, shattering all her thoughts into fragments. This was exactly what she wanted to say on the tenth breath! Word for word! Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, gazing down at her, the smile at the corner of his lips growing ever deeper. He could see in Ye Qing's eyes, the original killing intent had been completely replaced by shock, and a deeply hidden—fear. This high-and-mighty Demonic Path Saint, at this moment, was like a fawn stared at by a tiger. The gears of fate, at this moment, quietly began to turn.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly sighed, that breath carrying a meaningful lament. 'Lady Ye Qing, have you ever thought about—the true purpose the Holy Sect sent you to the Tianqing Sect?' Ye Qing's eyes suddenly contracted. Chen Ji continued: 'Heavenly Fate Lock, Destiny's Chess Piece, Discarded Piece Recovery—how many of these terms have you heard?' Each word landed like a heavy hammer, brutally striking Ye Qing's heart. Her breathing became rapid, purple-black spiritual energyfluctuationing violently at her fingertips, yet it never erupted. Chen Ji knew he had struck true.

Ye Qing was silent for a long time. The candlelight in the hall flickered gently, casting shifting shadows across her face. Those purple eyes were filled with complex, indescribable emotions. After a long while, she slowly spoke, her voice hoarse as if she had endured prolonged drought: 'What are your conditions?' Chen Ji set down his teacup, a satisfied curve appearing at the corner of his lips. He knew this Holy Woman of the Demonic Path had made her choice—not from fear, but from interest, and because in the prophecy he had shown, she had glimpsed some possibility in her own fate. 'Conditions?' He stood up and slowly walked toward the window. 'Simple. First, before this seat completes his arrangements, the Holy Sect's actions against the Tianqing Sect must be communicated in advance. Second, this seat needs you to use the 'Demonic Path Mist' to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record—though of course, it won't be free.' He turned around, his gaze falling on Ye Qing. 'In exchange, this seat will tell you a truth about your own destiny.'

Ye Qing frowned: 'For example?' Chen Ji didn't answer directly but slowly walked to her side, lowering his voice: 'Lady Ye Qing, have you heard a term—'Tianyan's Eye'?' The moment these four characters left his lips, the hall's temperature seemed to drop another degree. Ye Qing's body visibly stiffened. Those purple eyes flickered with an extremely hidden fear—a primal terror from the depths of the soul, something she herself couldn't explain.

These clues were like scattered chess pieces, requiring time to connect. 'Lady Ye Qing, how have you considered the matter of the Demonic Path Mist?' Chen Ji brought the conversation back on track. Ye Qing was silent for a moment, finally nodding: 'Agreed. But this seat has one condition.' Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: 'Please speak.' Ye Qing's gaze tightly locked onto him, those purple eyes flickering with a certain dangerous light: 'Your Foresight Ability, this seat wants to borrow it. Once.' Chen Jiwas momentarily stunned, then burst out laughing: 'Borrow?' Ye Qing's voice carried an unyielding quality: 'As a condition of cooperation, you must prophesy one thing for this seat—anything.'

Night Qing frowned, seemingly not understanding why he could still smile: "Aren't you afraid?" Chen Ji didn't answer, only turning to gaze at the night sky outside the window. The full moon hung high in the heavens, casting cold silver radiance, echoing the golden divine patterns flickering in his eyes just moments ago. "From the moment this seat stepped onto the path of cultivation, there was never any thought of a peaceful end." Night Qing fell silent for a moment before asking coldly: "Your prophecy, did it ever see your own date of death?" Those deep purple eyes flickered with complex light, as if re-examining this man she had regarded as waste. Her voice echoed in the empty hall, carrying a concern she herself hadn't noticed—an emotion beyond cooperation quietly taking root. Outside the hall, the night wind still blew, the bright moon still shone, and this night's game had only just begun to reveal its tip of the iceberg. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his smile growing deeper. He didn't answer, only slowly turning to walk toward the hall door, his tall silhouette stretching in the moonlight. "Date of death?" his voice drifted back lightly, "If this seat could see my own date of death, how could I have come this far?" As the words fell, his figure had already vanished beyond the hall door. Night Qing stood alone in the moonlight for a long time, motionless. She suddenly realized this man might be even more terrifying than she imagined—not because of his prophetic ability, but because of that heart as deep as the abyss.
